# Processed Data Directory

This directory contains processed datasets generated by the preprocessing pipeline.

## Generated Files

When you run `python scripts/preprocess_data.py`, the following files will be created:

### `training_data.csv`
- Merged and cleaned NHANES 2013-2014 dataset
- Features selected for model training
- Target variables (B12, anemia, diabetes risk) computed
- Missing values handled and ready for ML training
- Size: ~2MB typical

### `feature_names.json`
- List of feature column names
- Used for model compatibility and documentation
- Size: <1KB

## Usage

These files are automatically generated and should not be edited manually. To regenerate:

```bash
python scripts/preprocess_data.py
```

## Note

These processed files are excluded from git tracking to keep the repository size manageable. The raw data and scripts can always regenerate them.
